description:
## Outcome

The exact draft assets for macOS ARM64, macOS x86-64, Linux x86-64, and Windows x86-64 pass the full non-interactive release contract on native runners.

## Work

1. Download the exact draft assets and verify their external checksums before extraction.
2. Run `jido --version`, `--help`, `run --help`, `eval --help`, and `daemon --help` with no Erlang or Elixir on `PATH`.
3. Run one provider-free local scenario and prove exit statuses `0`, `1`, and `64`.
4. Run daemon start, health, request, clean stop, restart persistence, and no-daemon cases.
5. Test installation under paths with spaces and non-ASCII user profiles.
6. Validate metadata, notices, access controls, private runtime selection, JSONL, and artifact integrity.
7. Store target-scoped acceptance evidence with the release candidate.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] All four targets pass the same required check list.
- [ ] Tests use the final uploaded bytes, not a build directory.
- [ ] No test can find `erl`, `elixir`, or `mix` through `PATH`.
- [ ] No live provider credential or network model call is used.
- [ ] Daemon restart and shutdown evidence matches protocol and lifecycle policy.
- [ ] One required failure blocks later publication tasks.

## Tests

This task is the native acceptance suite. Also test that one deliberately corrupt candidate blocks the matrix.

## Non-goals

Do not treat this automation as manual TUI acceptance.
title: Pass automated packaged acceptance on the first target matrix
